method: micro-benchmark, identical payload (50-row nested doc, multilingual title), same machine, single run; serialize = stable canonical serialization, hash = sha256(stable), encrypt = Kaalka v5 encrypt_value
machine: Windows 11, same host for all three runtimes

startup_including_vm_and_script.note: totals include the benchmark workload itself; Dart AOT (dart compile exe) would reduce startup substantially — not measured

observations: JavaScript (V8) leads on all three ops (~2x Python).
Dart JIT leads Python on serialize/hash but trails on encrypt (NFKC time-key derivation path dominates; one sha256 + probe per call).
No language is pathologically slow; throughput parity is within ~4x band across runtimes.
